_about: Numbers REPORTED in Kerbl et al., 3D Gaussian Splatting (SIGGRAPH 2023), arXiv 2308.04079, method 'Ours-30K'. Different hardware (A6000) and their own code; never mixed with measured numbers. 'verified' says how each value was read.
_protocol_from_official_code: full_eval.py: Mip-NeRF360 outdoor scenes trained/evaluated on images_4, indoor on images_2; metrics.py: LPIPS with net_type='vgg' (their own lpipsPyTorch port; this repo uses the `lpips` package, VGG). Every 8th image held out (paper, Sec. 7.2). Blender scenes on a white background (paper, Sec. 7.2).

nerf_synthetic._source: Table 2 (PSNR only; the paper gives no per-scene SSIM/LPIPS for these scenes)

mipnerf360._source: Appendix D per-scene tables (PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS)
mipnerf360._verified: NOT verbatim: read from a summarising fetch of the arXiv HTML; the nine scenes average to Table 1's verbatim dataset averages (PSNR 27.21, SSIM 0.815, LPIPS 0.214). Check against the PDF appendix before shipping.
